subject: INC-1342: which host started with a different configuration
body:
Ivan Petrov (security) writing with a brief request. We think one inventory host loaded a different
configuration at startup. Let me know me which host it is and which key is set differently from the others.

The logs of every host for the incident window are in logs/, one file per host. The startup banner
prints the configuration one key per line.

Thanks, Ivan Petrov
